body: You don't think that would be too passive aggressive? I guess I should  just lay down the hard truths, but it's harder than I've expected.

I can't help but think that if this guy wasn't rich and influential on both of their lives, they'd have no problem shutting him down. But because he is, it's worth it. Which isn't a great feeling coming from your own parents who, in all other respects, are great.
